description: A tiny corpus for the evaluation harness: 12 documents, 30 chunks. The embedder of the tests has no semantics: a question is answerable either because its text is the text of a chunk (identical vector), or because its filters isolate the expected document.

chunks: The Governing Council decided to lower the interest rate on the main refinancing operations by 5 basis points to 0.00 percent.
The rate on the deposit facility will be decreased by 10 basis points to -0.40 percent.
Monthly purchases under the asset purchase programme will be expanded to 80 billion euro starting in April.

metadata.title: Introductory statement to the press conference, 10 March 2016

chunks: Based on our regular economic and monetary analyses, we conducted a thorough review of the monetary policy stance.
Annual HICP inflation in the euro area is expected to remain negative in the coming months and to pick up later in 2016.

metadata.title: Account of the monetary policy meeting of 9-10 March 2016

chunks: Members widely shared the assessment that the outlook for inflation had deteriorated since the December meeting.
A large majority of members supported the proposed package of measures.
Some members expressed reservations about a further reduction of the deposit facility rate.
The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent.
The stance of monetary policy remains accommodative after this increase.

metadata.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, 15-16 December 2015

chunks: Participants judged that there had been considerable improvement in labor market conditions this year.
Some members said that their decision to raise the target range was a close call.
Staff continued to project that real GDP would expand at a moderate pace.

metadata.title: Transcript of Chair Yellen's press conference, 16 December 2015

chunks: This action marks the end of an extraordinary seven-year period during which the federal funds rate was held near zero.
The process of normalizing interest rates is likely to proceed gradually.
The median projection for the federal funds rate at the end of 2016 is 1.4 percent.
Participants generally projected that inflation would rise to 2 percent over the medium term.

metadata.title: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee meeting ending on 3 August 2016

chunks: The Committee voted unanimously to reduce Bank Rate by 25 basis points to 0.25 percent.
The Committee voted by a majority of 6-3 to expand the purchases of UK government bonds.
Following the referendum, the outlook for growth in the short to medium term had weakened markedly.
The fall in sterling is likely to push up CPI inflation in the near term.
GDP growth is expected to slow sharply in the second half of the year.
The projections are conditioned on a path for Bank Rate implied by market yields.

metadata.title: Statement by the Governor: monetary policy decision, 3 May 2016

chunks: At its meeting today, the Board decided to lower the cash rate by 25 basis points to 1.75 percent.
This follows information showing inflationary pressures are lower than expected.

metadata.title: Rapport sur la politique monetaire, juillet 2016

chunks: La Banque prevoit que la croissance du PIB reel du Canada sera de 1,3 % en 2016.
Les feux de foret en Alberta ont reduit la production de petrole au deuxieme trimestre.
L'inflation mesuree par l'IPC devrait revenir a 2 % en 2017.

metadata.title: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Meeting on January 28 and 29, 2016

chunks: The Bank decided to introduce quantitative and qualitative monetary easing with a negative interest rate.
A negative interest rate of minus 0.1 percent will be applied to current accounts that financial institutions hold at the Bank.
